jobs.title: Systems Software Manager, CPU
jobs.description:
NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world.

We are seeking a Systems Software Manager to lead our Taiwan Tegra MODS team. The team develops diagnostic software that enables NVIDIA data center products to progress through hardware bring-up, validation, and production.

You will combine people management with hands-on technical leadership, helping engineers solve complex problems and deliver reliable diagnostic software. Working with architecture, hardware, firmware, and global software teams, you will shape the team’s technical direction, strengthen its capabilities, and drive consistent execution across a broad range of data center product programs

  

**What you’ll be doing:**
-------------------------

* Lead, mentor, and grow a systems software engineering team, supporting recruitment, performance management, career development, and the growth of technical leaders.
* Own planning and delivery for the Taiwan Tegra MODS team, balancing new feature development, platform enablement, software quality, and urgent program needs.
* Guide development of diagnostic tests for CPU and DC platforms, from requirements and design through implementation, validation, and maintenance.
* Provide technical direction through architecture discussions, design and code reviews, and hands-on debugging when needed.
* Partner with hardware, firmwar
